title: Crash in Object destructor when calling `_instance_bindings[i].free_callback` (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable on Android (seen in Google Play crash reports for the Android Editor)
- Didn't check if there are reports for other versions

### System information

Android 14, 15, 16 Beta on various devices

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.

From a quick grepping of the codebase, I believe instance bindings are only used by GDExtension (and maybe the Mono module?).

So this is probably something that happens due to some GDExtension, sadly we don't have more details about the environment of the users who got this crash.

It may be an expected crash for users upgrading from 4.5 to 4.6 with a 4.5 GDExtension that's somehow broken, though I believe we're trying what we can to avoid such crashes.

CC @godotengine/gdextension
